Name: Magical Valley Interface Event Lookup Patch
Author: 2heartgirl
Description:
I spent 20 minutes in photoshop color matching the Event Lookup mod's assets to match Magical Valley because somebody asked nicely for me to do it.


[u][b]Install:[/b][/u]

-> Unzip download from this page
-> Go to your Event Lookup mod
-> Navigate to the folder inside Event Lookup labeled "assets"
-> Drag and drop images from download into the assets folder
-> Replace/overwrite images when prompted
